stem: 某金融机构的一名反洗钱分析师正在审查自动交易监控系统生成的警报，以判断应将其上报反洗钱部门作进一步调查，还是作为误报归档。该分析师采取以下哪项行动较为合理？

options.B: 向负责引发警报账户的关系经理请求信息
options.C: 进行线下测试，以确保自动化监控系统运行有效
options.D: 向引发警报的交易所涉及的交易对手银行发送信息请求

stem_en: An AML analyst at a financial institution is examining an alert generated by the automated transaction monitoring system to determine whether the alert should be escalated to the AML unit for further investigation or archived as a false positive. Which action might be reasonable for the AML analyst to take?

options_en.A: Restrict the client's access to the account
options_en.B: Request information from the relationship manager assigned to the account that caused the alert
options_en.C: Perform below-the-line testing to ensure the automated monitoring system is operating effectively
options_en.D: Send a request for information to the counterparty bank involved in the transactions that caused the alert
